description: Shell script for testing Git sparse checkout functionality, including setup, various read-tree scenarios, sparse patterns, and worktree modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
